messages:
marta: Heads-up — after the 16:40 UTC incident we need an emergency docs addendum: update the outage entry, add the workaround (prefix cache clear + restart), and link to the status page. I pushed a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — requesting quick reviews.

kenji: Thanks. Can you paste the exact status page URL here (so the link in the docs is canonical)? Also is the workaround verified on Dedicated?

marta: Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-21-redis-kv. Workaround verified on Dedicated and Hosted in staging — steps are in the PR description. We should add a NOTE under "Known issues" that clients on older SDKs may need to clear local cache.

lina-docs: Quick suggestion: turn the workaround into a numbered step list and add a short rationale line. Also CI preview is currently failing for the PR (markdown frontmatter lint). I can fix the frontmatter if you want. :eyes:

ci-bot: [build-preview] docs-preview for pr/482 — FAILED — see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7890 (lint error: missing `sidebar_position` in frontmatter)

marta: Ugh — thanks, lina. Please add `sidebar_position` (keep it next to similar outage entries). Also, add a short code sample for the SDK cache-clear helper. Example to include:

```python
# client cache clear (v0.9+)
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.cache.clear(prefix='kv:')
```

kenji: For the snippet, can you use the `with` pattern we standardized? e.g. `with Client() as c:` so it closes. Minor but consistent.

marta: Good call — I'll update. Lina, if you can patch the frontmatter I'll re-trigger the preview. Who can be primary reviewer? @alex?

alex: I can take it. Will do a pass after the preview passes. If everything looks good, let's hold merge until after the rollback window ends at 18:00 UTC (we don't want a docs change during active rollbacks).

lina-docs: Frontmatter fix pushed in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 — added `sidebar_position` and `aliases`. Re-running preview.

ci-bot: [build-preview] docs-preview for pr/482 — STARTED

ci-bot: [build-preview] docs-preview for pr/482 — SUCCESS — preview available at https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/482

alex: Reviewed. Two nits in wording (made inline comments) and one request to reiterate that this is a post-incident hotfix, add timestamp. Otherwise :thumbsup:.

marta: Addressed Alex's nits, standardized snippet to `with Client() as c:` and added the incident timestamp + status page link. Updated PR description to reference incident postmortem when available.

alex: Approved and set to merge on 18:05 UTC (10 minutes after rollback window). Please include a short changelog entry in the release-notes doc.

sre-bot: Incident note: outage record created — incident ID INC-2026-03-21-REDIS-KV. Docs addendum linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

marta: Merged at 18:05 UTC. Changelog entry added to `/docs/process/release-notes/2026-03.md`. Thanks everyone — please monitor error rates for the next 30m and ping #incidents if anything spikes. :rocket:

kenji: Thanks — will watch.

lina-docs: I'll backfill a short 'what changed' blurb in the docs changelog and add the snippet to the SDK migration guide.

alex: Nice work team.
